name: RT Mobile Diagnostics
niche: taller mecanico / auto repair (mobile dealer-level diagnostics, key and module programming)
niche_note: Discovered under a 'locksmith' search due to key-programming overlap, but the Google Business category, real truck decal and reviews confirm it is a mobile automotive diagnostics and programming shop, not a locksmith. Built and registered under the correct niche.
address: 8732 NW 119th St, Hialeah Gardens, FL 33018, United States
address_source: Google Business Profile. This is a mobile, truck-based service ('WE COME TO YOU' printed on the service truck's tailgate decal), so the site frames this as a base location and service area rather than a walk-in storefront.
phone_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js), matches the phone number printed on the real service truck decal photo (305.942.7429).
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website field). WebSearch for "RT Mobile Diagnostics" Hialeah Gardens turned up no matching business page. curl -I on 4 domain guesses (rtdiagnosticmobile.com, rtmobilediagnostics.com, rtdiagnosticllc.com, rtdiagnostics305.com) all failed to resolve (no DNS record via getent hosts), confirmed as unregistered, not a connectivity fluke (example.com resolved fine in the same check).

social_media.evidence: WebSearch '"RT Mobile Diagnostics" Robert Hialeah Gardens instagram facebook' returned no matching business page, only unrelated Quest Diagnostics / medical imaging results. No social handle is printed on the truck decal either (only the phone number).

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), WebSearch for a Facebook/Instagram page (none found), no business website to pull a contact address from. Consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's note that home-service/mobile trades rarely publish email; phone is the real channel here.

services.source: Real service truck decal photo (gallery-logo) plus Google review mentions (key programming x3, auto engine diagnostic x2, code clearing x2). No prices published anywhere; site uses 'Quote on call' framing, never invented numbers.
list: Module Programming (PCM, BCM, ABS, TCM, used module setup)
Full System Diagnostics, Electrical and CAN Bus Diagnostics, Pre & Post Scans
Dealer-Level / OEM Programming (Ford FDRS, GM ACDelco TDS, Stellantis WiTech 2.0, Nissan Consult 4+, Honda i-HDS), Online Programming

reviews_verbatim.name: Antony Castellano
reviews_verbatim.text: Highly recommend RT Diagnostic! They quickly figured out the issue with my car and even programmed a new key fob for me on the spot. Great service, honest people, and very fair prices.

reviews_verbatim.name: Nathalie Pinero
reviews_verbatim.text: I had an excellent experience with this diagnostic car service. Robert was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to thoroughly diagnose my vehicle. He clearly explained the issue and answered all of my questions.

reviews_verbatim.name: deppster11
reviews_verbatim.text: Best in the business; I had a couple codes on my 6.6 Duramax. Robert cleared them for me and advised me to change my temp sensor. Easy and affordable fix, no more issues.

reviews_verbatim.name: Luis Riesgo
reviews_verbatim.text: Fast and reliable service and price. Had a couple of codes and he resolved it quickly. Also programmed a key for me as well. Definitely recommend.

reviews_verbatim.name: Kenneth Gonzalez
reviews_verbatim.text: Highly recommend! Honest and upfront! Great customer service with very good prices. Overall a great experience, will definitely be back.

photo_curation_note: 11 real photos were retrieved from Google Maps via gmaps_photocycle.js; gmaps-2.jpg was an exact duplicate of gmaps-1.jpg and was excluded. All 10 remaining were inspected visually (Read tool): all show genuine vehicle/equipment/work content, no closed-eye mid-procedure shots, no selfies, no text/caption overlays baked into the image itself (dashboard screen text is incidental context, not a caption graphic), so all 10 were used.
